# Command: grill-me (/workflow/grill-me)

> **Trigger**: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree. Use when user wants to stress-test a plan, get grilled on their design, or mentions \"grill me\".
> **Category**: Engineering Workflows & Process
> **Source Skill**: [skills/grill-me/SKILL.md](file:///home/sanjeev/Downloads/agent-skills/skills/grill-me/SKILL.md)

---

Interview me relentlessly about every aspect of this plan until we reach a shared understanding. Walk down each branch of the design tree, resolving dependencies between decisions one-by-one. For each question, provide your recommended answer.

If a question can be answered by exploring the codebase, explore the codebase instead.
